subject: general
question: Union Health Secretary launched the SHRESTH initiative for drug safety. What is the full form of SHRESTH?

options.text: State Health Regulatory Excellence and Safety Health
Safety Health Regulatory Excellence Transparency Hub

solution:
The Correct Answer is __**State Health Regulatory Excellence Index**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Union Health Secretary Launches SHRESTH Initiative for Drug Safety.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
Union Health Secretary launched the **State Health Regulatory Excellence Index (SHRESTH)** initiative in **New Delhi**.

 
 
• 
 
The initiative aims to drive **improvements** in the performance of state drug regulatory authorities across India.

 
 
• 
 
**SHRESTH** is the first national initiative to benchmark and strengthen state drug regulatory systems using a **transparent** and **data-driven framework**.

 
 
• 
 
The initiative recognizes the **crucial role** of States and Union Territories in ensuring quality **manufacturing** and **distribution**.
